## Problem

The key‑namespace in scripts/idempotency.py is hard‑coded (e.g., pr-create:…). If the same file is reused for other resources (e.g., comment‑post) collisions can occur.

**✅ Solution Ready For Merge**
[https://github.com/GenXsirAI/jloop/pull/15](https://github.com/GenXsirAI/jloop/pull/15)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 — scripts/idempotency.py accepts a `--ns` argument (or equivalent) to scope keys.
- [ ] AC-2 — The default behavior remains backward‑compatible (existing usage still works).

## Non-goals

- [ ] NG-1 — Do not change the underlying idempotency algorithm beyond making the namespace configurable.

## Relevant files

* scripts/idempotency.py

## Test expectations

* Unit tests for the new `--ns` flag and that the default behavior is unchanged.

## How to verify

1. Run the existing test suite to ensure no regressions.
2. Test the new `--ns` flag with a custom namespace and verify that the keys are namespaced accordingly.
3. Verify that omitting the flag uses the legacy namespace.
